text_block_list.text: One day, in the dance studio――

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey! Could you please come be an 
audience member for my live show?!

Through the smooth, practiced charm of the 
girl who suddenly spoke to me, I ended up 
acting as her one-person audience.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Sparkling chestnut hair is my trademark☆ 
Always cute, everyone's favorite Umadol!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I'm Smart Falcon, but you can call me 
Falco♪ Make sure to call me Falco, okay~?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Next up is what you've all been waiting 
for: call and response time☆ When I call 
out, I want everyone to answer with 
"Falco!", okay?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Fal-fal-fal-fal~? ……YES!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Oh-ho, getting a teeeeny bit shy, are we? 
Let's go one more time!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Fal-fal-fal-fal~?! ……YES!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Yay! Thank youuu☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, call-and-response really feels the 
best! Since we're at it, I want an even 
longer one~!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Let's Pretty?" "Fal-co~!" "Sparkling 
Umadol?" "Fal-co~!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...Like that?! Eek, you're a genius!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Taking notes, taking notes~!

Afterward, rumors circulated of her being 
spotted in the library, furiously filling 
page after page in her notebook.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I see...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Still, feeling shy during a live is a 
no-go! Let's keep at it until the shyness 
is gone!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Falco's gonna hype things up to the max, 
so muster your courage and get into the 
groove!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Aaaand here I go~â

Afterward, thanks to her ingenuity and 
creativity, I found myself cheerfully 
bantering right back before I even 
realized it.
